title: The combinatorial Hopf algebra of signed graphs
summary: The theory of combinatorial Hopf algebras (CHA) is a powerful framework for studying algebraic invariants of combinatorial objects. For instance, Stanley's chromatic symmetric function and the chromatic polynomial arise naturally from the CHA of graphs. In this paper, we define a CHA of signed graphs in order to study, in the same spirit, invariants of signed graphs such as the signed chromatic polynomial.
